title: Delicious Low Fat Prawn Tandoori Delight
description: A flavorful and healthy low-fat prawn dish made with tandoori spices and served with a side of rice.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, tandoori spice mix, lemon juice, ginger, and garlic.
2. Add the prawns to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Remove the prawns from the marinade and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
7. Add the cooked prawns to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
8. Serve the prawns with a side of cooked white rice and garnish with chopped cilantro.
9. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
